label: Before repairs
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: KING LEO area 23, The Ballroom, STATE 0 before repairs. Generate one portrait 9:16 environment still. The input is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the approved gate's warm royal 3D animation quality, but create this DIFFERENT location.
STYLE: Premium warm royal 3D animated-film environment: rounded bevelled cream sandstone, honey oak, polished brass, royal blue and gold, vivid healthy greenery, warm sunlight, clean dimensional materials. Bright cartoon colour, no gritty photorealism, no gloomy brown wash. Portrait 9:16, fixed camera, readable repair subjects, no UI or typography.
SCENE AND ALL INITIAL DAMAGE: Grand royal ballroom viewed from one end, cream stone, blue and gold trim, warm daylight through tall windows. Damaged parquet dance floor, two fallen brass chandeliers on the side floor below empty ceiling mounts, broken musicians' gallery at back left, torn blue royal banners on back wall, tarnished gold-framed mirrors on right wall, scuffed damaged grand doors at rear centre, broken buffet tables at side edges, unlit wall lamps. COMPOSITION: fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, fit the entire small room or courtyard into one portrait composition, broad readable shapes, keep every listed repair subject visible and spatially separated. No collage or cutaway panels. Main room occupies central 75%, a quiet foreground floor or path occupies lower 20%, architecture visible above. Clear 3D depth, soft shadows and ambient occlusion; materials are smooth but detailed, not plastic toys. The space needs repair but is still cheerful, sunlit, colourful and inviting.
LATER repairs, NONE done yet, in this exact order: 1. Repair the dance floor; 2. Restore the chandeliers; 3. Fix the musicians' gallery; 4. Rehang the banners; 5. Re-gild the mirrors; 6. Repair the grand doors; 7. Restore the buffet tables; 8. Relight the hall.
Do not add living characters unless explicitly required. No UI, labels, readable words, logos, watermark, floating icons, particles, construction workers or tools being operated. One standalone portrait image with no border.
